_about: Brand → legal-name aliases for the data-engineer-h1b sponsor screen (v0.5.0; closes the [TODO: DEV] alias table). Each entry points the name a job-seeker types to ONE exact company_name in data/80-days-to-stay/80-days-csv/mapped_student_employment_targets_v3.csv. Used only when exact matching fails; never fuzzy. rules.json → aliases.require_review = true, so an entry with reviewed_by_person: false is shown as alias-pending-review and its row stays unscored. Label: model-judgment while unreviewed (Claude proposed it), your-input once a person has reviewed it.

aliases.why: Gemini (the crypto exchange, Greenhouse board 'gemini') came back not-in-csv in the 2026-10-03 run. Its legal entity is believed to be Gemini Space Station, LLC.
aliases.corroboration_from_csv: Row is New York, NY, industry 'Other Banking and Financial Services'; the posting lists New York, NY. Both are record values; that they point to the same employer is a judgment.
aliases.reviewer_should_check: The legal name in the footer or terms of use of gemini.com, or the registrant name in SEC EDGAR.
aliases.review_note: Accepted by Ethan Gomes, 2026-10-21: legal name checked with a Google search.

aliases.why: Robinhood came back not-in-csv in the 2026-10-03 run because normalization keeps the word 'Markets'. The listed company is Robinhood Markets, Inc.
aliases.corroboration_from_csv: Row is Menlo Park, CA, industry 'Other Technology'; the posting lists Menlo Park, CA. Both are record values; that they point to the same employer is a judgment.
aliases.reviewer_should_check: The legal name on robinhood.com's legal or investor-relations pages, or the registrant name in SEC EDGAR.
aliases.review_note: Accepted by Ethan Gomes, 2026-10-21: legal name checked with a Google search.

aliases.why: Discovery on 2026-10-20 found an Upstart posting (Greenhouse board 'upstart'). The CSV has five UPSTART rows; UPSTART NETWORK INC (Palo Alto, CA) carries the H-1B data (316 approvals), UPSTART HOLDINGS INC carries none.
aliases.corroboration_from_csv: Row is Palo Alto, CA, industry 'Other Banking and Financial Services', the same city and industry as UPSTART HOLDINGS INC (upstartholdings.com). Record values; that the posting's employer is the Network entity is a judgment.
aliases.reviewer_should_check: Which Upstart entity is the employer of record for engineering hires (offer letters, the legal page on upstart.com, or SEC EDGAR subsidiaries list).
aliases.review_note: Accepted by Ethan Gomes, 2026-10-21: legal name checked with a Google search.

aliases.why: Discovery on 2026-10-20 found a Unite Us posting (Greenhouse board 'uniteus'). Exact matching fails: 'unite us' is not 'unite usa'.
aliases.corroboration_from_csv: Row is New York, NY, industry 'Other Technology', with Senior/Staff Data Engineer among its sponsored titles. CAUTION: the row's website field is unite-usa.com, not uniteus.com. That could be a data error or a different company.
aliases.reviewer_should_check: The legal entity name on uniteus.com (terms or privacy page), and whether unite-usa.com is the same company.
aliases.review_note: Accepted by Ethan Gomes, 2026-10-21: legal name checked with a Google search. The caution in corroboration_from_csv (CSV website unite-usa.com) still stands.
